notes: While you wear it, any Critical Hit against you becomes a normal hit.

While wearing it, you can’t be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors unless you allow it.
You cast Plane Shift only on a successful DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check made as part of the Magic action.
On a failed check, you and each creature and object within 15 feet travel to a random destination rolled on a 1d100 table.

The compartment holds air for 10 hours of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.
The 2d6 pressure damage applies below a depth of 900 feet. No unbroken span of the text states that condition, so it is left as a note.
You have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage while you wear it.
Metal Shell: as a Magic action you gain Immunity to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for 10 minutes or until you are no longer wearing the armor. Once used, not again until the next dawn.

You have Resistance to one of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage while wearing it.

When an attacker makes a ranged attack roll against a target within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to become the target instead.

Dumped beans explode in a 10-foot-radius Sphere; each creature in it, including you, takes the 5d4 on a failed save or half as much on a success.

A planted bean produces an effect chosen by the GM or rolled on a 1d100 table. The saves and damage in that table's rows (01: DC 15 Constitution, 5d6 Poison; 81–90: DC 20 Constitution, 10d6 Force) belong to the rows and are not typed on the item.
When part of a living creature is placed in the bag, there is a 50 percent chance it is pulled inside.
A creature inside can escape with a DC 15 Strength (Athletics) check. Another creature can pull it out with a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.
Any creature that starts its turn inside the bag is devoured.
The bag holds up to 500 pounds, not exceeding 64 cubic feet, and weighs 5 pounds. Placing it in another extradimensional space destroys both and opens a gate to the Astral Plane.
As a Magic action you pull out a fuzzy object that becomes a creature rolled on the 1d8 table for the bag’s color (gray, rust, or tan).
Once three fuzzy objects have been pulled from the bag, it can’t be used again until the next dawn.
The bead explodes in a 10-foot-radius Sphere. The 5d4 is dealt on a failed save. A success deals no damage.
A creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped in a sphere of force for 1 minute.
Provides as much nourishment as 1 day of Rations.
Your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
You know Dwarvish and have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to interact with dwarves and duergar.

Your Strength changes to the belt’s score. It has no effect if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than that score.
While attuned, your Hit Point maximum increases by 1 for each level you have attained.
Curse: you have Disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons other than this one.
Whenever another creature damages you while the weapon is in your possession, you must succeed on the save or go berserk.
Your steps make no sound, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
You cast Levitate on yourself only.

After a total of 10 minutes of use, the magic ceases to function for you until you finish a Long Rest.

You have Resistance to Cold damage, tolerate temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower, and ignore Difficult Terrain created by ice or snow.

The candle burns for 4 hours in total.
This property can’t be used again until the next dawn. Teleporting leaves a cloud of smoke that Lightly Obscures the space you left until the end of your next turn.
Four sizes exist, chosen or rolled on a 1d100 table, each with its own capacity and Fly Speed (80, 60, 40, or 30 feet). Fly Speed is halved above normal capacity.
As a Magic action you summon an Air Elemental that obeys you for up to 1 hour. Not usable again until the next dawn.

The circlet can’t cast this spell again until the next dawn.
The web fills twice its normal area. Once used, the Web property can’t be used again until the next dawn.

Creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. The property stops until the start of your next turn when you take damage, and is suppressed while your Speed is 0.
Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
As a Magic action you expend 1 charge to give yourself the Invisible condition for 1 hour.

You can breathe underwater and have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.

Suggestion is cast through the sensor, needs no Concentration, ends if Scrying ends, and can’t be cast this way again until the next dawn.
You have Truesight with a range of 120 feet centered on the spell’s sensor.
Each spell takes the targets to the plane keyed to the side of the cube pressed.

As a Bonus Action the weapon hovers, flies up to 30 feet, and attacks using your attack roll. After its fourth attack it returns to you.
Geyser: one creature of your choice in a Line 30 feet long and 1 foot wide takes the 1d4 and has the Prone condition on a failed save.

A drawn card makes an illusion of a creature rolled on a 1d100 table.
A creature that takes a Study action identifies the illusion with a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

You and each creature and object within a 10-foot Emanation have the Invisible condition for 2d4 minutes. It ends for a creature after it attacks, deals damage, or casts a spell.

Within 1 foot you have Darkvision and Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to examine something.

A touched boat or ship can’t be moved by any means for 24 hours.

A 50-foot-long boat that moves at 6 miles per hour for 24 hours.
A nonmagical oak tree 60 feet tall.

Becomes a Griffon for up to 6 hours. Not usable again for 5 days.
Becomes a Giant Fly (stat block given) for up to 12 hours. Not usable again for 2 days.
A pair. Each becomes a Lion for up to 1 hour. Not usable again for 7 days.

Not usable again for 15 days.

One of the Ivory Goats. Becomes a Giant Goat for up to 3 hours. Not usable again for 30 days.

While you hold the weapon, you have Resistance to Fire damage.
When you draw it, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet. Not again for 1 hour.
Your Strength is 19 while you wear them. They have no effect if your Strength is 19 or higher without them.

Unknown Spell: you can try to cast a level 1+ Wizard spell you don’t know by expending a slot and succeeding on an Intelligence (Arcana) check (DC 10 plus the spell’s level). On a success, not again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

On a failed check, a 1d100 table gives a random effect. Its spells (Enlarge/Reduce, Faerie Fire, Fireball, Gust of Wind, Invisibility, Lightning Bolt, Phantasmal Force, Polymorph, Stinking Cloud) belong to that table’s rows and are left out of spells.
Spells cast from the hat use your spell save DC and spell attack bonus.
Your Intelligence is 19 while you wear it. It has no effect if your Intelligence is 19 or higher without it.

notes: The helm has 1d10 diamonds, 2d10 rubies, 3d10 fire opals, and 4d10 opals. Each spell uses and destroys one gem: Daylight an opal, Fireball a fire opal, Prismatic Spray a diamond, Wall of Fire a ruby.

Once either spell is cast from the helm, that spell can’t be cast from it again until the next dawn.

Your Dexterity increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.

As a Reaction, cancel a spell of level 8 or lower cast by a creature you can see. Burns out after canceling 20 levels of spells.
Your Wisdom increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
Your Intelligence increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
Your Charisma increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
You regain 15 Hit Points at the end of each hour it orbits your head if you have at least 1 Hit Point.
Stores up to 4 levels of spells cast into it (1d4 levels when found). You can cast a stored spell, using the original caster’s slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability.
Your Strength increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.

Each benefit applies while the stone orbits your head. Ability increases are left untyped because of their maximum of 20.
You make a ranged attack roll with a bonus equal to your Dexterity modifier plus your Proficiency Bonus. On a hit, the target has the Restrained condition until you release it.
A creature can break the bands with a DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

The save is forced only if the flask is empty and the target is native to another plane. On a failure the target is trapped in the flask. A target trapped before has Advantage.
A released creature obeys your commands for 1 hour.
When you hit with an attack roll, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.
Lightning Bolt: the target and each other creature in a 5-foot-wide Line take the 4d6 on a failed save or half as much on a success. Not usable again until the next dawn.

Luck: you can reroll one failed D20 Test and must use the second roll. Not again until the next dawn.
Wish: once used, not again until the next dawn. The weapon loses this property when it has no charges. The text states no regaining of charges.

Any creature other than you that sees its reflection in the activated mirror within 30 feet must succeed on the save or be trapped in one of twelve extradimensional cells. A creature that knows the mirror’s nature has Advantage, and Constructs succeed automatically.
